title: narcissus tazetta var. cypri
intro: Narcissus tazetta var. cypri, commonly known as the Cyprian Daffodil, is a subspecies of the Narcissus tazetta plant, which is a type of flowering bulbous perennial native to Asia and Europe. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the potential to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus tazetta var. cypri include antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and other respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
